sloka: यो ऽसौ नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुरारुह्य घण्टानिनदप्रणादम् ।गजं खरं गर्जति वै महात्मा महोदरो नाम स एष वीरः ।। ६.५९.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: yo 'sau navārkoditatāmracakṣurāruhya ghaṇṭāninadapraṇādam ।gajaṁ kharaṁ garjati vai mahātmā mahodaro nāma sa eṣa vīraḥ ।। 6.59.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."
